# Sikander Arts

> Painting contractor in Karachi, Pakistan. This website describes painting services, provides an online painting cost calculator, and offers contact details for project quotations.

Sikander Arts provides interior and exterior painting, texture and decorative finishes, waterproofing, wood polish, metal painting, commercial painting, and epoxy floor coating. Contact the team to confirm the scope and availability for a particular property or location.

The painting cost calculator provides a provisional estimate of painter charges, labour and materials using room dimensions in feet, paint quality, coats, location and selected extras. It uses configured estimates rather than a live market-price feed. Coverage, litres, wastage and whole-pack material pricing are available with editable example inputs; a chosen pack price replaces the area-based material charge. Optional roof work adds 5% of the painting subtotal. Scaffolding and minimum-job adjustment are separate. Door/window deductions apply only when woodwork is selected. Its formula is based on room wall and optional ceiling area; selecting a service name does not introduce a separate pricing formula for waterproofing, epoxy flooring or wood polish. These services require a project-specific quotation. The displayed estimate and range are not a confirmed quotation or a guarantee of final cost.

Phone and WhatsApp: +92 302 291 1088. Location: Kharadar, Karachi, Pakistan. Published business hours: Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM Pakistan time. Consult the contact page for current details and request a site visit to confirm pricing.

- [Painting cost calculator](https://sikanderart.com/calculate-cost): Online wall painting estimate with labour and material breakdown. Useful for planning paint labour costs in Karachi; final painter charges must be confirmed after reviewing the property and scope.
